title: accounts start empty, onboard immediately, sign in, and isolate content
expected: New accounts contain no inherited projects; session resumes onboarding; another account cannot read/delete their content.

title: software, education descriptions, exact crop, photo caption, and responsive crop dialog
expected: Saved tools and education render in preview; uploaded crop is exactly 50 by 40 pixels; caption persists; crop dialog fits mobile.

title: dev showcase is opt-in and reset clears accounts, projects, and sessions
expected: Only an authorized local owner can open showcase/reset; reset clears disposable accounts, content and invalidates sessions.

title: real dates preserve leap years, historical display and timezone-independent values
expected: Valid leap dates normalize consistently; impossible dates fail; historical partial dates and Present remain readable.

title: project and profile boundaries reject unsafe paths, links, duplicates and invalid ranges
expected: Six unique images and 100-character names pass; excess, duplicates, unsafe URLs/paths and reversed dates fail without mutation.

title: publication limits, unique identities and image caption mapping preserve their contracts
expected: 3?40-character valid handles and 20 unique projects pass; excess, duplicate identity and multiple featured projects fail; mapping preserves captions and source.

title: backups reject corruption and missing images while stripping account ownership
expected: Backups remain importable, strip owner/publication identity, and reject malformed JSON, unsupported versions, unsafe links and missing images.

title: missing routes and missing portfolios show an accessible recovery path
expected: Unknown routes return 404, explain recovery and link home; automated accessibility checks pass.

title: forged and expired sessions fail while valid sessions use protected cookies
expected: Forged/expired tokens return 401 or login redirect; valid login uses HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict, root-scoped cookie.

title: rejected setup updates preserve all saved content
expected: Invalid step, completion, fields, image counts and foreign origins fail; profile, projects and studio bytes are unchanged.

title: private preview has a usable empty state and accessible responsive saved content
expected: Empty preview offers recovery; saved biography appears privately and passes accessibility/overflow checks at all required widths; keyboard About navigation works.

title: a stale tab cannot overwrite a newer device draft
expected: Stale-tab save warns instead of overwriting a newer device version.

title: device draft persists offline, crops locally, previews, and backs up without server writes
expected: Offline changes survive reload, crops appear in preview and downloaded backups; no server mutation is made.

title: backup imports preserve unfinished work, reject unsafe data, and studio fits all widths
expected: Incomplete backups restore, unsafe imports fail, project save/discard and all nine sections remain usable at narrow and wide widths.

title: export accepts a supported image above the obsolete 5 MB limit and produces an importable backup
expected: A valid image above 5 MiB exports and reimports successfully.

title: export rejects files above 500 MiB and libraries that cannot fit the 768 MiB importer guard before reading them
expected: Oversized files/libraries are rejected before reading their contents; exporter fails with useful guidance.

title: landing signup starts blank, verifies, publishes, counts creators, and resumes the correct draft
expected: Signup starts blank, preserves guest draft, requires verification to publish, increments real creator count once and resumes the account draft.

title: hosted auth screenshots, keyboard access, duplicate signup, and verification-email recovery
expected: Auth pages pass accessibility/keyboard/layout checks; duplicate email and failed verification-email sending provide recoverable errors.

title: cancelled account replacement preserves both drafts and restore asks only once
expected: Cancelling draft replacement preserves both versions; restore confirms exactly once.

title: account deletion confirms identity, removes all hosted data and this device draft, and isolates others
expected: Wrong password/cancel preserve data; confirmed deletion removes own Auth/Firestore/Storage/device data; retry works and other accounts remain intact.

title: account drafts open when the obsolete active-draft localStorage key throws
expected: Unavailable obsolete storage key cannot prevent opening the account draft.

title: account autosave resumes unpublished work and images on a new browser and after local storage is cleared
expected: Autosaved unpublished text/images resume on another browser and after clearing local storage.

title: offline edits retry and divergent devices preserve both versions with an explicit choice
expected: Offline writes retry; divergent devices require a choice and preserve both versions.

title: published-only accounts recover automatically and failed lookups never create a blank cloud draft
expected: Published-only accounts recover; failed cloud lookup never replaces real data with a blank draft.

title: legacy device edits migrate and image failure leaves restore untouched
expected: Legacy edits migrate; failed image retrieval leaves the previous draft unchanged.

title: a replacement production server reads existing cloud drafts without seeding or resetting them
expected: A replacement production process reads the existing draft and revision without reseeding.

title: opening an old account draft does not silently adopt a newer publication revision
expected: Older private content keeps its own publication revision and never silently adopts newer published content.

title: chunked images cross the old limit, preserve bytes, and enforce ownership and 500 MB boundary
expected: 500 MiB admission boundary is enforced; 9 MiB chunk upload preserves bytes; wrong owner, duplicate chunks and obsolete direct-upload limit fail.

title: global image quotas and admission leases bound cross-account resource use
expected: Service storage/daily/admission quotas reject excess requests and reclaim abandoned reservations.

title: an upload started before deletion cannot recreate the account's image library
expected: An upload overlapping account deletion cannot recreate deleted image records.

title: drafts save incomplete content while cloud images require verification and remain private
expected: Incomplete text drafts save without verification; cloud images need verification and private images are owner-only.

title: restore repairs missing and foreign mappings using UID and rejects ambiguous or dangling records
expected: Restore repairs unambiguous ownership mappings; foreign/ambiguous/dangling assets are rejected.

title: URL ownership regression: missing indexes, atomic rename, retries, and released names
expected: Rename and retry preserve URL ownership; missing indexes recover and released names become available.

title: URL races and deletion retries never take another account's reused name
expected: Concurrent claims and deletion retries never take another account?s reused URL.

title: simultaneous first publishes keep one website per account
expected: Simultaneous first publications yield one website per account.

title: partial account deletion cleanup is UID-scoped after another account claims its name
expected: Partial cleanup stays scoped to the deleting UID after a different account reuses its URL.

title: publication requirements reject missing biography and projects on the server
expected: Server rejects publication without required biography or projects.

title: draft indicators, actionable publishing errors, automatic project commit, and URL editor
expected: Draft status and actionable errors track edits; publishing commits the open valid project; URL-only rename preserves private content.

title: publishing enforces identity, verification, address ownership, revision checks, and database rules
expected: Identity, verification, handle ownership, optimistic revision and database rules prevent unauthorized publishing.

title: create locally, publish images, update the same link, restore on another device, and isolate accounts
expected: Images publish and load publicly; private edits remain private until update; same link updates; another device restores without crossing accounts.

title: biography and homepage content persist, preview together, and can be removed
expected: Biography, tagline and banner save and render in preview; removals persist.

title: shared calendars validate dates, default to today, preserve legacy records, and format every view
expected: Calendar controls choose real dates, use today for new entries, retain historical records and format dates consistently.

title: featured selection replaces, removes, survives edits and deletion; responsive editing and public evidence
expected: Only one project is featured; replacement, deselection, edit and deletion preserve the intended featured state and responsive layouts.

title: service homepage, real-count states, redirects, and signup entry
expected: Landing links enter signup; creator counts display zero/singular/plural/unavailable honestly; legacy root routes redirect.

title: landing and unavailable auth remain accessible at all widths
expected: Landing and unavailable-auth screens pass accessibility, image loading, overflow, reduced-motion and keyboard skip-link checks at all widths.

title: authentication protects every editor and API; invalid requests never write
expected: All private editors/APIs reject anonymous access; invalid payloads/origins do not write; logout removes access.

title: onboarding saves, survives reload, reports failures, skips, and finishes
expected: Wizard autosaves each step, survives reload, allows skipping, finishes to dashboard and retains recovery data after a save failure.

title: dashboard profile CRUD and project create/edit/delete work; production stays frozen
expected: Education/experience and project CRUD persist; cancelled deletion preserves projects; preview updates while the built public snapshot stays frozen.

title: responsive pages, navigation, image loading, and accessibility
expected: Public and admin pages have working navigation/images, no overflow, no runtime errors and no automated accessibility violations at required widths.

title: recovery drafts cannot overwrite newer saved profile content
expected: Old recovery data never overwrites newer saved content; immediate preview flushes valid edits.

title: image picker rejects bad paths, uploads files, and enforces gallery capacity
expected: Bad image paths fail; valid crop uploads; gallery caps at six and removing an image reopens a slot.

title: blocked storage shows recovery guidance instead of crashing studio and preview
expected: Blocked browser storage shows actionable recovery guidance in editor/preview without crashing.

title: projects precede the complete biography and mobile studio keeps the first field in view
expected: Projects precede the complete biography; the first studio field remains visible on mobile.

title: publishing issues include all mandatory blanks while empty optional fields stay valid
expected: Required publication blanks all produce issues; empty optional fields remain valid.

title: optional supplied formats and date ranges remain validated; open editor replaces its saved project
expected: Supplied optional values/ranges are validated and the open editor replaces its matching saved project.

title: private feedback survives backups/cloud validation and old backups default to untouched
expected: Feedback metadata survives backup/cloud validation; old backups default to untouched feedback.

title: URL-only revision reconciliation preserves private edits without adopting newer public content
expected: URL revision reconciliation changes publication metadata without replacing private content.

title: preview and project errors clear on edits and every navigation path
expected: Correcting fields or changing sections clears transient validation errors on every navigation path.

title: all studio sections and populated controls fit narrow phones through desktop
expected: Populated controls and all nine sections fit 320?1920px; preview and key sections pass accessibility checks.

title: an image above 5 MB opens the cropper and oversized source gets the 500 MB message
expected: Images above 5 MiB open cropping; files above 500 MiB receive the current limit message.

title: hosted private endpoints reject anonymous requests without creating records
expected: Every supported private cloud method rejects anonymous access with 401 and creates no publisher or publication records.

title: invalid cloud updates preserve the previous draft and its revision
expected: Invalid format/revision/content/JSON fails with 400; stale saves fail with 409; the saved draft and revision remain identical.

title: hosted configuration is public-only and legacy file editing stays disabled
expected: Config exposes only browser Firebase fields, uses no-store and demo project; hosted local-file editing is disabled; unpublished URLs recover through 404.

title: original fonts load locally with third-party network access blocked
expected: All seven original font styles load from the local site with third-party requests blocked; no external request is attempted.
